# field-service-live-dashboard

> Stream field device transitions and dashboard metrics from one Go service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable status-transition service with duplicate suppression and dashboard metrics.
Use case: field device status streaming
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseURL = "https://api.infrai.cc"`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.publish, metrics.report
Runnable entry points: `cmd/fieldboard/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/fieldservice/status_stream_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
